CVE-2026-123368.title: compose-lint: .env read through a symlink outside the project can expose the CI job's environment
CVE-2026-123368.description: compose-lint is a Docker Compose security linter that identifies dangerous misconfigurations before deployment. From 0.22.0 until 0.31.0, compose-lint follows a sibling .env symbolic link outside the project without applying its normal containment check. From 0.28.0, the same gap also affects an include project_directory link outside the project. A pull request can reference a variable from the linked file, causing substitution to place runner file or process-environment data into finding messages written to logs, JSON, SARIF artifacts, and Code Scanning alerts. Reading /proc/self/environ can expose the remainder of the linter process environment because NUL-separated entries are treated as one value, although disclosure requires a workflow that processes untrusted changes with useful environment data and GitHub normally withholds secrets from fork pull requests. The pass or fail result is not changed. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.0.

CVE-2026-99368.title: NFSD: Do not send CB_RECALL_ANY to NFSv4.0 clients
CVE-2026-99368.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

NFSD: Do not send CB_RECALL_ANY to NFSv4.0 clients

deleg_reaper() sends CB_RECALL_ANY to every ACTIVE client holding
delegations, but CB_RECALL_ANY is an NFSv4.1 operation. An NFSv4.0
client's callback service accepts only CB_GETATTR and CB_RECALL, so it
replies OP_ILLEGAL. The decoder maps the unexpected opnum to -EIO, and
nfsd4_cb_done() marks the client's callback channel down.

Nothing brings the channel back. nfsd4_run_cb_work() sets NFSD4_CB_UP
only for a minor version above zero, and the only nfsd4_probe_callback()
call site an NFSv4.0 client reaches is nfsd4_setclientid_confirm(). One
visit from the reaper therefore leaves the channel marked down until the
client re-establishes its clientid. RENEW then returns
NFS4ERR_CB_PATH_DOWN for as long as the client holds delegations.
nfsd4_cb_channel_good() stops returning true, so the client is granted
no further delegations.

Skip clients at minor version zero.
